label: DRAFT2_E4_REBUILD
protocol_source: scripts/repeated_split_stability.py split rule and budget; top-k deletion by the final-margin score under the poisoned refit
depths_note: k = B for that split is added, so the grid has 7 depths per seed
holdout_note: the holdout is not zero-norm filtered, matching the existing convention; 8 such rows have margin 0 for every theta and are always counted incorrect
logloss_definition: unpenalized mean logistic loss on the holdout
mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial on paired holdout predictions within a single split; splits are never pooled
interval_type: repeated-split stability summary over 20 splits of one pool, NOT a confidence interval
